v4-review.rubric: Adversarially review the Archive-redesign diff. FAIL if any of the 8 audited slop tells survive: a header radial-glow orb, an eyebrow tracked-label directly above an oversized H1, a gradient accent underline/rule, a Sparkles (or decorative Lucide) icon in the cups header, accent-soft gold fills used for structural chrome (accent must be scarce — 5★ + at most one active state, ≤10% of surface), twee copy ("the Archive"/"a record of every cup"/"end of the trail"/"nothing in this corner"), a competing big-number stat banner, or a flat decorative accent-dot timeline rail (R1, R2, R3). FAIL if the Unforgettable Cups strip is not kept on top + horizontally scrollable (R2), or the timeline is not year-grouped + chronological with tabular-nums counts and preserved expand-details (R3). FAIL if tapping a bean does not open BeanDetailCard via the morph or the morph is not transform/opacity-only (R4, R9). FAIL if Restore (→ SEALED) or Delete (destructive + confirmed) is missing/unreachable on the card, or Learn / Edit-photo regressed (R5). FAIL if ownership (days owned / finished) or a saved brew profile (Aiden / hand-brew) that ArchiveDetailSheet showed is lost (R6). FAIL if search or any filter (year, min-rating, roaster, origin, process, sort) regressed or stops filtering the cups strip + timeline (R7). FAIL if the three distinct empty states (first-run, filtered-empty, no-5★ cups) are not all present (R8). FAIL if reduced-motion does not disable the morph (R9). FAIL if BeanDetailCard changes are not additive/prop-gated (Rotation / Inventory regress), or the diff touches Firebase reads/writes, the bean data model, statuses, restore/delete logic, other tabs' behavior, or onboarding (R10). Also FAIL on design-bank violations: more than one accent, heavy/glow shadows, non-hairline structural dividers, missing tabular-nums on counts, or motion >300ms / not ease-out. PASS only when all 8 slop tells are gone, the structure + every feature are preserved, the morph is reused cleanly, and the diff is scope- and design-clean.

v5-human.prompt: On the dev app (device): open Archive and confirm the masthead, Unforgettable Cups strip, and timeline now read as Apple-caliber (no glow/slop); tap a 5★ cup and a timeline bean and confirm each flies open via the morph; on the card back use Restore and confirm Delete is reachable + confirmed, and that ownership + any saved brew profile show; run a search and a filter and confirm both the cups strip and timeline respond — proving R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7 and the overall feel.

goal.definition_of_done: The Archive masthead has no glow orb / no gradient rule / no eyebrow-over-H1 / no twee title and a single tabular-nums stat line; the Unforgettable Cups (5★) strip stays on top as a restrained trophy-card carousel with no Sparkles icon, horizontally scrollable; the year-grouped timeline stays below with neutral surfaces, hairline grouping, tabular-nums counts, and preserved expand-details; tapping any finished bean (cup card or row) morphs the bag into BeanDetailCard (bag flies, no teleport); the card back exposes Restore (→ SEALED) and Delete (destructive, confirmed) plus Learn and Edit-photo, and renders ownership (days owned / finished) + saved brew profile when present; search and every filter (year, min-rating, roaster, origin, process, sort) still filter both the cups strip and the timeline; the three distinct empty states remain; reduced-motion disables the morph; accent (gold) is scarce (5★ + one active state); `npx vite build` exits 0; the Archive Playwright harness renders multi-year finished mock beans with the cups strip scrollable, the timeline year-grouped + chronological, a working tap→morph, search/filter reducing visible beans, no header glow, no Sparkles, reduced-motion with no flight, and zero console errors; verify-inventory and verify-morph still PASS (no BeanDetailCard regression); codex review is clean against the rubric; and Tal signs off on device that the Archive now feels Apple-caliber, not slop.
goal.statement: Keep the Archive's structure (Unforgettable Cups hero strip on top, year-grouped timeline below) but 100x the craft to anti-slop / Apple-caliber and wire tap → trading-card hero morph. Kill the 8 audited slop tells (header glow orb, eyebrow-over-H1, gradient accent rule, Sparkles icon, accent-soft pill spam, twee voice, big-number stat banner, flat decorative timeline rail). Reuse BeanDetailCard + the manual-FLIP morph; add Restore/Delete to the card back and port ownership + saved brew profile so no feature is lost. Visual/UX only; no Firebase or feature changes; dev only.

scope_guard: Do NOT change Firebase reads/writes, the bean data model, statuses, or restore/delete/finish logic (layout/presentation only).
Do NOT make non-additive BeanDetailCard changes — all new props (onRestore, onDelete, ownership, brew profile) must be optional and render only when passed, so Rotation and Inventory do not regress.
Do NOT change WHAT Archive shows (still FINISHED beans) or which actions exist (Restore, Delete, Learn, Edit photo, brew-profile viewing, tasting history) — only how they look and are triggered.
Do NOT touch other tabs' behavior or onboarding; retire ArchiveDetailSheet only AFTER card parity is verified.
Do NOT animate any non-transform/opacity property; do not introduce a second accent or glow shadow; do not deploy to production or merge to main (dev channel only).
